description: This file defines a service class 'GeminiService' that provides a wrapper around the Google Generative AI SDK for synchronous text generation. It manages configuration via environment variables, handles authentication, model selection, and response parsing, and defines custom exceptions for error handling.

classes.name: GeminiConfigurationError
classes.description: Custom exception raised for configuration issues, such as missing API keys.

classes.name: GeminiProviderError
classes.description: Custom exception raised when the Gemini API provider returns an error or request fails.

classes.name: GeminiService
classes.description: Main class providing a simple wrapper around Google Generative AI SDK for synchronous text generation, managing configuration and response parsing.
